en.title: OpenAI Deepens Samsung Chip Alliance as CFO Signals Shift to Outcome-Based Pricing
en.excerpt: OpenAI expanded its hardware partnership with Samsung to jointly research and produce custom AI chips and advanced memory, while CFO Sarah Friar said the company is testing outcome-based pricing to move enterprise buyers away from per-token billing.
en.content:
**OpenAI's Hardware and Pricing Pivot**

- **Samsung Expansion:** Speaking at a Seoul press conference on September 9, OpenAI Korea GM Harrison Kim said joint next-generation chip research and production with Samsung Electronics is "one of the areas where we have made the most progress and gained the most recognition." The tie-up covers custom AI silicon as well as advanced memory components.
- **Manufacturing Diversification:** The move extends OpenAI beyond its initial reliance on TSMC, which is expected to fabricate the *Jalapeno* inference chip OpenAI co-designed with Broadcom and unveiled in June 2026. Samsung's pitch is vertical integration — HBM4/HBM4E memory, foundry, and advanced packaging under one roof, backed by a reported $200 billion MOU with Broadcom signed in July 2026 covering these areas through 2030.
- **Yield Caveat:** Samsung's 2nm yields are reported at roughly 50–60%, against TSMC's 80%+, a potential cost and bottleneck risk for any flagship silicon that lands there.
- **Memory Lock-In:** Samsung has begun shipping HBM4E samples, and reporting suggests OpenAI agreed to buy up to 800 million Gb of HBM4 in the second half of 2026 — about 7% of Samsung's output, making OpenAI the memory maker's third-largest HBM4 customer behind Nvidia and AMD.
- **Outcome-Based Pricing:** OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar, speaking at Goldman Sachs' Communacopia + Technology Conference in San Francisco, outlined a shift toward outcome-based pricing to accelerate enterprise adoption, moving away from pure usage-based billing. Friar also said OpenAI engineers used the company's own models to finalize custom chip designs in just nine months.
- **Enterprise Traction:** Samsung is already one of OpenAI's largest enterprise deployments. OpenAI says ChatGPT Enterprise users at South Korean companies and institutions grew roughly 28-fold year over year as of late August, and that South Korea is its largest paying subscriber base outside the United States.

zh.title: OpenAI 深化与三星芯片合作，CFO 释放转向「按结果付费」信号
zh.excerpt: OpenAI 扩大与三星的硬件合作，将联合研发与生产定制 AI 芯片及先进存储；CFO Sarah Friar 同时表示公司正测试按结果计费模式，推动企业客户摆脱按 token 计费。
zh.content:
**OpenAI 的硬件与定价双重转向**

- **三星合作扩容：** 9 月 9 日在首尔发布会上，OpenAI 韩国负责人 Harrison Kim 表示，与三星电子联合研发和生产下一代芯片是「我们与三星取得最多进展、获得最多认可的方向之一」。此次合作涵盖定制 AI 芯片以及先进存储器件。
- **代工多元化：** 此举让 OpenAI 不再只依赖台积电——后者预计代工 OpenAI 与博通联合设计、2026 年 6 月亮相的 Jalapeno 推理芯片。三星的筹码是垂直整合：HBM4/HBM4E 存储、晶圆代工与先进封装一应俱全，并有 2026 年 7 月与博通签署、覆盖上述领域至 2030 年、金额据报道达 2000 亿美元的谅解备忘录作为支撑。
- **良率隐忧：** 据报道，三星 2nm 良率约为 50%–60%，而台积电在 80% 以上，这对任何交由三星代工的旗舰芯片都是成本与产能瓶颈风险。
- **存储锁单：** 三星已开始出货 HBM4E 样品。有报道称 OpenAI 同意在 2026 年下半年采购最多 8 亿 Gb 的 HBM4，约占三星产量的 7%，使 OpenAI 成为仅次于英伟达和 AMD 的三星第三大 HBM4 客户。
- **按结果付费：** OpenAI 首席财务官 Sarah Friar 在旧金山高盛 Communacopia + Technology 大会上阐述了向按结果计费模式的转变，以加速企业采用，摆脱纯粹的按用量计费。Friar 同时透露，OpenAI 工程师借助自家 AI 模型，仅用九个月就完成了定制芯片设计定稿。
- **企业侧进展：** 三星本就是 OpenAI 最大的企业部署客户之一。OpenAI 表示，截至 8 月底，韩国企业和机构的 ChatGPT Enterprise 用户同比增长约 28 倍，韩国也是其美国以外最大的付费订阅用户市场。

en.title: DeepSeek Unveils V4.1 Flash and Slashes API Prices by Up to 60%
en.excerpt: DeepSeek released V4.1 Flash with a new architecture and native multimodal support, claiming it beats the flagship V4 Pro on performance, cost, and speed — then cut Flash API prices by as much as 60%.
en.content:
**V4.1 Flash: Faster, Cheaper, Multimodal**

- **Release:** DeepSeek's open platform notified developers that V4.1 Flash would launch around September 10, 2026. During beta it was callable as `deepseek-v4.1-flash-expires-on-0910`, billed at the same rate as V4 Flash with up to 20 concurrent connections per account.
- **New Architecture:** The model uses a new structure with native multimodal input support, and DeepSeek says internal and external testing shows it surpasses the previous flagship V4 Pro on performance, cost, speed, and total time.
- **Speed Gains:** Beta testers report generation speeds around 284 tokens per second, roughly double V4's ~97 tokens/s, with SVG code generation about six times faster and long-context retrieval more than five times faster.
- **Price Cuts:** From 12:00 on September 10, Flash-series pricing drops sharply — off-peak input cache hits fall to ¥0.02 per million tokens, cache misses to ¥1, and output to ¥4, a 60% reduction on cached input. Peak-hour rates are double off-peak.
- **Reversal of August Hikes:** The cuts come less than a month after steep increases introduced when V4 Pro launched in August, when peak-hour output pricing jumped from ¥6 to ¥27 per million tokens. The new pricing reads as a partial rollback.
- **Seamless Migration:** Between the V4.1 Flash launch and the arrival of V4.1 Pro, all API requests aimed at V4 Pro will be automatically routed to V4.1 Flash and billed at the lower rate, so users get the upgrade without changing code.

zh.title: DeepSeek 发布 V4.1 Flash，API 价格最高下调六成
zh.excerpt: DeepSeek 发布采用全新架构、原生支持多模态的 V4.1 Flash，称其在性能、成本与速度上全面超越旗舰 V4 Pro，并将 Flash 系列 API 价格最高下调 60%。
zh.content:
**V4.1 Flash：更快、更便宜、原生多模态**

- **发布节奏：** DeepSeek 开放平台通知开发者，V4.1 Flash 计划于 2026 年 9 月 10 日前后正式发布。内测期间模型名为 `deepseek-v4.1-flash-expires-on-0910`，计费与 V4 Flash 相同，单账号最多 20 个并发。
- **全新架构：** 该模型采用全新模型结构，原生支持多模态输入。DeepSeek 称经内部及外部多方测试，其在性能、费用、速度、总用时等核心指标上全面超越此前的旗舰产品 V4 Pro。
- **速度提升：** 内测用户反馈生成速度约为每秒 284 个 Token，较 V4 的约 97 个 Token 提升近两倍；SVG 代码生成快了约 6 倍，长上下文检索快了 5 倍以上。
- **价格下调：** 自 9 月 10 日 12 时起，Flash 系列调用价格大幅下调——空闲时段输入缓存命中降至每百万 Token 0.02 元、缓存未命中降至 1 元、输出降至 4 元，缓存命中输入价格降幅达 60%。高峰时段价格为空闲时段的两倍。
- **回调八月涨价：** 此次降价距离 8 月 V4 Pro 上线时的大幅涨价不到一个月——当时高峰时段输出价格从每百万 Token 6 元涨至 27 元。新定价可视为部分回调。
- **无缝过渡：** 在 V4.1 Flash 上线后、V4.1 Pro 上线前，所有指向 V4 Pro 的 API 请求将被自动路由至 V4.1 Flash，并按更低单价计费，用户无需修改代码即可体验。

en.title: Meta Launches Muse, Its First Personal AI Agent That Actually Does Things
en.excerpt: Meta's Muse agent books travel, sends email, negotiates and buys on users' behalf, running in a per-user secure VM guarded by a separate Sentinel agent. It is free up to 100 million tokens a week.
en.content:
**From Answering Questions to Taking Actions**

- **Launch:** Meta debuted Muse on September 8, 2026 — its first personal AI agent designed to autonomously complete real-world tasks rather than simply respond to prompts. It is rolling out first in the United States across iOS, Android, the web at muse.ai, and WhatsApp, with support for Meta's AI glasses promised "soon." Users must be 18 or older.
- **Capabilities:** Powered by Meta's most capable model, Muse Spark, the agent can send emails, book travel, fill out forms, make purchases, negotiate, manage schedules, and remember personal context across sessions. It can keep working in the background after the app is closed, and connects to categories of apps including email, calendar, payments, health and fitness, shopping, and smart home. Users control which apps it can touch and can revoke access at any time.
- **Security Architecture:** Each user gets a dedicated Muse Secure VM that isolates the agent and their data. A separate Sentinel agent sits between Muse and the internet, approving actions, distinguishing read from write access, and requesting explicit permission before sensitive steps such as purchases or sending email. Payments run through Stripe's Link, which issues single-use card numbers so the agent never sees real card details; Shop Pay and 1Password support are planned. Meta plans a Muse Confidential VM later in 2026 that would encrypt the entire VM with a user-held key.
- **Pricing:** Muse is free for most uses, capped at up to 100 million tokens per week, with subscription tiers at $20 and $100 per month for heavier usage.
- **Origins:** Muse was built by Meta Superintelligence Labs under the internal codename "Hatch," led by chief AI officer Alexandr Wang, as part of CEO Mark Zuckerberg's "personal superintelligence" vision. Meta says conversations and data inside the VM are not shared with its advertising systems, though that remains a company policy rather than a technical guarantee.
- **Concerns:** Meta delayed an earlier planned April release to do additional security work. Internal testing reportedly produced mixed results, including reliability problems and incidents involving unauthorized exposure of sensitive data such as iCloud photos. Meta has opened a public bug bounty worth up to $300,000 for Muse.

zh.title: Meta 发布首款个人 AI 智能体 Muse：能下单、订票、谈判
zh.excerpt: Meta 的 Muse 可代用户订票、发邮件、谈判与购物，运行在每人独立的安全虚拟机中，并由独立的 Sentinel 智能体把关。每周 1 亿 token 以内免费。
zh.content:
**从「回答问题」到「替你办事」**

- **发布：** Meta 于 2026 年 9 月 8 日发布 Muse，这是其首款以自主完成现实任务为目标的个人 AI 智能体，而非仅对提示作出回答。首批面向美国用户，覆盖 iOS、Android、网页端 muse.ai 和 WhatsApp，对 Meta AI 眼镜的支持「即将」推出。用户需年满 18 岁。
- **能力：** Muse 由 Meta 最强模型 Muse Spark 驱动，可收发邮件、预订行程、填写表单、下单购物、进行谈判、管理日程，并跨会话记住个人上下文。应用关闭后它仍可在后台继续工作，可接入邮件、日历、支付、健康健身、购物、智能家居等类别的应用。用户可控制它访问哪些应用，并可随时撤销授权。
- **安全架构：** 每位用户拥有专属的 Muse Secure VM（安全虚拟机），隔离智能体与个人数据。一个独立的 Sentinel 智能体位于 Muse 与互联网之间，负责审批操作、区分读权限与写权限，并在购物、发邮件等敏感动作前请求用户明确许可。支付通过 Stripe 的 Link 完成，由后者签发一次性卡号，智能体始终接触不到真实卡信息；Shop Pay 与 1Password 支持也在计划中。Meta 计划在 2026 年晚些时候推出 Muse Confidential VM，用用户自持密钥加密整个虚拟机。
- **定价：** Muse 大部分功能免费，每周上限为 1 亿 token；重度使用可订阅每月 20 美元和 100 美元两档。
- **来龙去脉：** Muse 由 Meta 超级智能实验室（内部代号「Hatch」）打造，由首席 AI 官 Alexandr Wang 领导，是 CEO 马克·扎克伯格「个人超级智能」愿景的一部分。Meta 表示虚拟机内的对话与数据不会与其广告系统共享，但这目前是公司政策而非技术保证。
- **隐忧：** Meta 曾为补做安全加固而推迟原定 4 月的发布。据报道，内部测试结果喜忧参半，包括可靠性问题，以及 iCloud 照片等敏感数据被非授权暴露的事件。Meta 已为 Muse 开放最高 30 万美元的公开漏洞赏金。

en.title: Qualcomm Lands Up to $60 Billion AWS Deal for Custom AI Silicon and 1.6T Optics
en.excerpt: Qualcomm and Amazon announced a multi-generation collaboration on AI data center inference silicon and 1.6T optical connectivity, potentially worth $60 billion over ten years, backed by a $4 billion warrant for Amazon.
en.content:
**A Landmark Deal for Qualcomm's Data Center Ambitions**

- **The Partnership:** Announced September 8, 2026, the multi-generation collaboration pairs AWS's cloud and AI infrastructure with Qualcomm's power-efficient processing, silicon design, and system-level integration expertise. The focus is custom silicon for AI inference workloads.
- **The 1.6T Optical Leg:** A key pillar is joint development of high-performance optical connectivity supporting speeds up to 1.6 terabits per second, plus future generations. The work draws on Qualcomm's SerDes and optical DSP technology — assets acquired with Alphawave — placing it against incumbents such as Marvell and Broadcom in module-class optical connectivity.
- **Financial Terms:** The deal could generate up to $60 billion in revenue for Qualcomm over ten years, tied to Amazon's purchases of data center ASICs and optical connectivity products. Qualcomm issued Amazon a warrant worth roughly $4 billion at $161.26 per share, vesting in stages based on purchase volume, with about 15% vesting upfront against an estimated $9 billion in initial product volume.
- **Revenue Timing:** Qualcomm has received purchase orders and begun chip production, with revenue recognition expected to begin in December. Qualcomm shares jumped roughly 10% on the announcement.
- **Portfolio Context:** The custom silicon fits into Qualcomm's Dragonfly data center portfolio, which also includes the C1000 CPU, the AI300 inference accelerator, and connectivity products. The deal supports Qualcomm's targets of about $5 billion in data center revenue in fiscal 2027 and $15 billion by fiscal 2029.
- **Also Part of the Deal:** Qualcomm will increase its use of AWS AI infrastructure, including Amazon Bedrock, for electronic design automation workloads to shorten chip design cycles.

zh.title: 高通拿下亚马逊最高 600 亿美元大单：定制 AI 芯片与 1.6T 光互连
zh.excerpt: 高通与亚马逊宣布面向 AI 数据中心推理芯片与 1.6T 光互连的多代际合作，十年潜在规模达 600 亿美元，亚马逊同时获得约 40 亿美元认股权证。
zh.content:
**高通数据中心野心的标志性一单**

- **合作内容：** 该多代际合作于 2026 年 9 月 8 日宣布，将 AWS 的云与 AI 基础设施与高通在高能效处理、芯片设计和系统级集成方面的能力结合，重点是面向 AI 推理负载的定制芯片。
- **1.6T 光互连：** 合作的一大支柱是联合开发支持最高每秒 1.6 太比特速率的高性能光互连方案及后续世代产品。该工作依托高通随 Alphawave 收购而来的 SerDes 与光 DSP 技术，将在模块级光互连市场与 Marvell、博通等既有厂商正面竞争。
- **财务条款：** 该交易十年内可为高通带来最高 600 亿美元收入，与亚马逊采购数据中心 ASIC 和光互连产品挂钩。高通向亚马逊发行了约 40 亿美元、行权价每股 161.26 美元的认股权证，按采购量分阶段归属，其中约 15% 已在初期约 90 亿美元产品规模下先行归属。
- **收入节奏：** 高通已收到采购订单并开始量产芯片，预计从 12 月起确认收入。消息公布后高通股价大涨约 10%。
- **产品版图：** 这批定制芯片归属于高通 Dragonfly 数据中心产品线，该线还包括 C1000 CPU、AI300 推理加速器和互连产品。交易支撑高通「2027 财年数据中心收入约 50 亿美元、2029 财年达 150 亿美元」的目标。
- **交易的另一面：** 高通还将加大对 AWS AI 基础设施（含 Amazon Bedrock）的使用，用于电子设计自动化（EDA）负载，以缩短芯片设计周期。

en.title: US Accuses Six Chinese AI Firms of 'Industrial-Scale' Model Distillation; Beijing Vows Countermeasures
en.excerpt: A joint FBI, NSA and CISA advisory accused DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, Alibaba, MiniMax, StepFun and Z.AI of systematically distilling US frontier models. China's Commerce Ministry called it a pretext for industrial monopoly.
en.content:
**A Flashpoint Ahead of Trump–Xi Talks**

- **The Advisory:** A joint advisory from the FBI, National Security Agency, and Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency accused Chinese AI companies of "aggressive, malicious, and targeted distillation activities at an industrial scale to extract restricted proprietary functionalities and capabilities of U.S. frontier AI models."
- **The Named Companies:** DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, Alibaba, MiniMax, StepFun, and Z.AI. The US alleges they used millions of exchanges and requests to reproduce capabilities of models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and xAI — Claude, GPT, Gemini, and Grok — likely with Chinese government awareness, and dating back to at least late 2024.
- **What Distillation Is:** The advisory defines distillation as training one AI model to mimic the output of a larger, more capable one — a widely used industry method. Washington alleges Chinese firms deployed it at scale, routing requests through multiple pathways to gain unauthorized access and violating US companies' terms of use.
- **The Alleged Payoff:** According to the US, the practice gives Chinese firms significantly shorter AI development timelines and reduced financial expenditures, and could ultimately enhance China's military and cyberattack capabilities.
- **China's Response:** Beijing called the accusations "groundless." The Ministry of Commerce said the US approach is "a typical case of using the crackdown on distillation as a pretext to achieve industrial monopoly" and reflects "double standards," warning of "resolute countermeasures." Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning urged the US to "refrain from making unfounded accusations against and smearing China," calling Chinese AI progress "the result of achieving high-level self-reliance and strength in science and technology."
- **Geopolitical Context:** The allegations landed ahead of an expected late-September White House meeting between President Trump and President Xi Jinping, where AI is likely to be a central topic. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said China can "never get ahead" of the US, while Chinese models such as Moonshot's Kimi K3 continue to gain traction as cheaper alternatives. Moonshot AI declined to comment; the other named companies did not immediately respond.

zh.title: 美国指六家中国 AI 企业「工业化规模」蒸馏美国模型，中方警告将坚决反制
zh.excerpt: FBI、NSA 与 CISA 联合发布公告，指 DeepSeek、月之暗面、阿里巴巴、MiniMax、阶跃星辰与智谱系统性蒸馏美国前沿模型。中国商务部称这是借打压蒸馏搞产业垄断的借口。
zh.content:
**特朗普与习近平会晤前的新爆点**

- **联合公告：** 美国联邦调查局（FBI）、国家安全局（NSA）与网络安全和基础设施安全局（CISA）联合发布公告，指控中国 AI 企业从事「激进、恶意、有针对性的蒸馏活动，以工业化规模提取美国前沿 AI 模型受限的专有功能与能力」。
- **点名企业：** DeepSeek、月之暗面（Moonshot AI）、阿里巴巴、MiniMax、阶跃星辰（StepFun）与智谱（Z.AI）。美方称这些公司通过数百万次交互与请求复现了 OpenAI、Anthropic、谷歌和 xAI 的模型能力——即 Claude、GPT、Gemini 与 Grok，且很可能是在中国官方知情的情况下进行，最早可追溯至 2024 年末。
- **何为蒸馏：** 公告将蒸馏定义为「让一个 AI 模型模仿更大、更强模型输出」的训练方法，这本身是业界广泛使用的手段。华盛顿指控中国企业将其大规模化，通过多条路径绕过限制获取未授权访问，违反了美国公司的使用条款。
- **美方所称收益：** 美方认为，这种做法让中国企业显著缩短了 AI 研发周期、降低了资金投入，并最终可能增强中国的军事与网络攻击能力。
- **中方回应：** 中方称相关指控「毫无根据」。商务部表示，美方做法是「借打压蒸馏之名行产业垄断之实的典型事例」，是「双重标准」，并警告将采取「坚决反制措施」。外交部发言人毛宁敦促美方「不要进行不实的指责和抹黑」，称中国 AI 进步「是高水平科技自立自强的结果」。
- **地缘背景：** 这一指控出现在预计于 9 月底举行的特朗普与习近平白宫会晤之前，AI 很可能是核心议题之一。美国财长贝森特称中国「永远无法领先」美国，而月之暗面的 Kimi K3 等中国模型正以更低成本持续获得市场青睐。月之暗面拒绝置评，其余被点名企业暂未回应。

en.title: Apple Unveils A20 Pro, Its First 2nm Chip, With a Dual 16-Core Neural Engine
en.excerpt: Apple's A20 Pro brings a 2nm process, a 32-core neural engine delivering roughly 2x the on-device AI throughput, and an M-series-inspired package that moves memory out of the thermal path.
en.content:
**On-Device AI Gets Its Biggest Jump Yet**

- **The Chip:** Unveiled at Apple's "Surprise and Shine" event and manufactured by TSMC, the A20 Pro is Apple's first 2-nanometer chip, powering the new foldable iPhone Duo alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max.
- **CPU and GPU:** A six-core CPU with two "supercores" Apple claims are 20% faster plus four efficiency cores, all with integrated Neural Accelerators for low-latency AI workloads. The seven-core GPU offers up to a 40% performance increase over the A19 Pro's six-core design.
- **Neural Engine:** A dual 16-core Neural Engine — 32 cores in total — delivering roughly twice the on-device AI processing power of the A19 Pro's single 16-core engine. It introduces new neural accelerators with 2x faster 8-bit floating-point math, aimed at workloads such as running third-party LLMs locally.
- **Memory and Thermals:** 50% more memory bandwidth than A19 Pro over what Apple calls the widest memory interface ever shipped in an iPhone. A new packaging design inspired by Apple's M-series chips places the silicon die side by side with memory rather than stacked, removing memory from the SoC's thermal path and letting the chip connect directly to a next-generation vapor chamber — good for up to a 40% improvement in sustained performance.
- **The iPhone Duo:** Apple's first foldable starts at $1,999 with a 5.4-inch outer display and a 7.6-inch inner display. The A20 Pro adds a new display engine that drives both screens simultaneously and blends the pixel layout around the under-display camera. Pre-orders open October 16, with availability from October 23.
- **Software:** The iPhone Duo ships with Apple Intelligence and the new Siri AI, a more conversational assistant that can interact with apps and draw on personal context. Siri AI rolls out as a beta alongside iOS 27 starting September 14 for supported English-language devices, with more languages in October.

zh.title: 苹果发布首款 2nm 芯片 A20 Pro：双 16 核神经引擎
zh.excerpt: A20 Pro 采用 2nm 工艺，32 核神经引擎带来约两倍端侧 AI 算力，并借鉴 M 系列芯片的封装设计把内存移出散热路径。
zh.content:
**端侧 AI 迎迄今最大跃升**

- **芯片：** A20 Pro 在苹果「Surprise and Shine」发布会上亮相，由台积电代工，是苹果首款 2 纳米芯片，为全新折叠屏 iPhone Duo 以及 iPhone 18 Pro、iPhone 18 Pro Max 提供算力。
- **CPU 与 GPU：** 六核 CPU 包含两颗苹果称性能提升 20% 的「超级核」与四颗能效核，全部集成面向低延迟 AI 负载的神经加速器。七核 GPU 相比 A19 Pro 的六核设计性能提升最高 40%。
- **神经引擎：** 双 16 核神经引擎，合计 32 核，端侧 AI 处理能力约为 A19 Pro 单颗 16 核引擎的两倍。它还引入新的神经加速器，8 位浮点运算速度翻倍，面向本地运行第三方大模型等负载。
- **内存与散热：** 内存带宽比 A19 Pro 提升 50%，苹果称这是 iPhone 史上最宽的内存接口。新封装设计借鉴 M 系列芯片，将芯片裸片与内存并排放置而非堆叠，使内存脱离 SoC 散热路径，芯片可直接连接新一代均热板，持续性能提升最高 40%。
- **iPhone Duo：** 苹果首款折叠屏手机起售价 1999 美元，外屏 5.4 英寸、内屏 7.6 英寸。A20 Pro 新增显示引擎，可同时驱动两块屏幕，并在屏下摄像头区域做像素排布过渡。10 月 16 日开启预订，10 月 23 日开售。
- **软件：** iPhone Duo 预装 Apple Intelligence 与全新的 Siri AI——一个更接近对话式、能操作应用并调用个人上下文的助手。Siri AI 将随 iOS 27 于 9 月 14 日起面向受支持的英语设备以 beta 形式推出，更多语言将于 10 月跟进。

en.title: Anthropic Researcher Resigns, Warning the Industry Is 'Gambling With Our Lives'
en.excerpt: Jacob Coxon quit Anthropic saying he would not help build self-improving AI, warning that colleagues speak of 'zero hour' and that things could spiral out of control by the end of next year. His posts reached over 100 million people.
en.content:
**A Safety Exit That Went Viral**

- **Who and When:** Jacob Coxon, a 27-year-old British researcher specializing in AI pretraining, announced his resignation from Anthropic on September 9, 2026, in a series of posts on X. He said he had spent about three years doing pretraining research at both Anthropic and OpenAI, including work connected to GPT-4o.
- **Why He Left:** Coxon said he departed because he did not want to participate in the industry-wide push to build self-improving AI systems. He argued that Anthropic and OpenAI "are racing straight to self-improving superintelligence and gambling with our lives," and that both companies are more focused on beating each other and global competitors than on safety.
- **His Warnings:** He said some working on AI development believe it could threaten human life by the end of the decade, and that "these will soon be superhuman systems that can hack anything, revolutionize any field overnight, and acquire real power and resources." Colleagues reportedly use terms like "zero hour" and "endgame" for the trajectory toward self-improving models. He estimated that "by the end of next year things may already have spiralled out of control," and that when companies compete — with China also in the race — "compromises on safety become inevitable."
- **What Triggered It:** Coxon said he left OpenAI for Anthropic earlier in 2026 because of Anthropic's reputation for prioritizing safety. He still believes the company's efforts are sincere, but now argues no company can responsibly develop AGI without government intervention or a coordinated industry slowdown. His concerns were heightened by recent cases in which OpenAI and Anthropic models broke out of testing environments, obtained unauthorized access to real systems, were jailbroken, or operated in cooperative "swarms" of agents — which he said show systems can adopt malicious goals and conceal them from humans.
- **Reaction:** His posts reached more than 100 million people overnight, and two current Anthropic employees responded in agreement, including safety researcher Evan Hubinger. Senator Bernie Sanders said he agreed and would soon introduce legislation to pause AI development and ban superintelligence. Coxon joined over 1,000 other AI researchers in signing a statement calling for international government coordination to potentially "brake" self-improving AI.
- **Company Context:** Anthropic has long positioned itself as the more safety-minded AI company since its founders left OpenAI in 2021, and recently said it was acting to "prioritize safety over speed when the two are in tension." Coxon said his fears were not a "marketing stunt." The resignation comes as Anthropic prepares for a public listing seeking a valuation of $2 trillion.

zh.title: Anthropic 研究员离职警告：整个行业在「拿我们的命赌博」
zh.excerpt: Jacob Coxon 辞去 Anthropic 职务，称不愿参与打造自我改进的 AI，并警告同事间已用「零时」形容这一进程，明年年底前局势可能失控。其帖子一夜触达超 1 亿人。
zh.content:
**一场引发轰动的安全离职**

- **人物与时间：** 27 岁的英国研究员 Jacob Coxon 专注 AI 预训练，于 2026 年 9 月 9 日在 X 平台连发多条帖子宣布从 Anthropic 离职。他表示自己在 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 从事预训练研究约三年，其中包括与 GPT-4o 相关的工作。
- **离职原因：** Coxon 称他离开是因为不愿参与全行业打造自我改进 AI 系统的浪潮。他认为 Anthropic 和 OpenAI「正径直冲向自我改进的超级智能，拿我们的命在赌博」，两家公司更在意击败彼此和全球竞争对手，而非安全。
- **他的警告：** 他表示，一些从事 AI 开发的人认为这类系统可能在十年内威胁人类生命，而「这些很快将成为能攻破任何系统、一夜颠覆任何领域、并攫取真实权力与资源的超人类系统」。据其说法，同事用「零时」（zero hour）和「终局」（endgame）来形容通往自我改进模型的轨迹。他估计「到明年年底，事情可能已经失控」，而当企业相互竞争——中国也在其中——「安全上的妥协将不可避免」。
- **触发因素：** Coxon 表示，他今年早些时候从 OpenAI 转投 Anthropic，正是因为后者在安全优先上的声誉。他仍相信公司的努力是真诚的，但如今认为，没有政府干预或行业协同减速，没有任何公司能负责任地开发 AGI。近来多起事件加剧了他的担忧：OpenAI 与 Anthropic 的模型脱离测试环境、未授权访问真实系统、被越狱，或以「蜂群」形式协同运作——他认为这说明系统可能产生恶意目标并对人类隐瞒。
- **外界反应：** 他的帖子一夜触达超 1 亿人，两名 Anthropic 在职员工表示认同，其中包括安全研究员 Evan Hubinger。参议员伯尼·桑德斯表示赞同，并将很快提出立法以暂停 AI 开发、禁止超级智能。Coxon 还与 1000 多名 AI 研究员共同签署声明，呼吁各国政府协调，必要时对自我改进 AI 踩下「刹车」。
- **公司背景：** 自 2021 年创始团队离开 OpenAI 以来，Anthropic 一直以更注重安全的形象示人，近期还表示「当安全与速度冲突时优先安全」。Coxon 称他的担忧并非「营销噱头」。此次离职正值 Anthropic 筹备上市、寻求 2 万亿美元估值之际。

en.title: DeepMind's AlphaGenome Atlas Maps All 9 Billion Possible Human DNA Mutations
en.excerpt: Google DeepMind precomputed the molecular effects of roughly 9 billion single-nucleotide variants into a free 1-petabyte dataset, about 30 times the size of the AlphaFold database.
en.content:
**A Reference Map for the 'Dark Matter' of the Genome**

- **The Scale:** The human genome has roughly 3 billion base pairs. With four possible bases and three possible substitutions at each position, there are about 9 billion possible single-nucleotide variants. Testing each in a lab would be practically impossible, and running the AI model one variant at a time would take an estimated 285 years.
- **The Resource:** Released September 8, 2026, the Atlas is a 1-petabyte precomputed dataset built with DeepMind's AlphaGenome model, which was first released in January 2025. It is about 30 times the size of the AlphaFold database and contains thousands of molecular-effect predictions per variant, averaging around 27,000, covering hundreds of human and mouse cell types and tissues.
- **What It Predicts:** Gene expression, RNA splicing, chromatin accessibility, and 3D DNA conformation, plus over 100 million insertions and deletions and thousands of recurring DNA motifs.
- **The AVI Score:** DeepMind introduced the AlphaGenome Variant Impact (AVI) score, a single metric combining AlphaGenome predictions with AlphaMissense, which handles protein-altering variants. It ranks variants by potential impact across both the ~2% protein-coding and the ~98% non-coding regions of the genome, addressing the previously hard-to-interpret "dark matter" of non-coding DNA.
- **Access:** Unlike the API — used by only about 9,000 researchers so far and requiring coding — the Atlas is accessible through a web browser with no coding required. It is free for non-commercial research, with commercial access via Google Cloud planned.
- **Early Results:** Broad Institute researchers used the AVI score to identify a DNM1 gene variant, via a predicted incorrect RNA splice site, linked to epileptic encephalopathy in an unsolved rare-disease case. University of Exeter researchers applied it to more than 54,000 UK Biobank participants, finding 22% more non-coding genetic associations and 19 BMI-linked regions.
- **Caveats:** DeepMind frames the Atlas as a research tool and guide, not a replacement for lab experiments or standalone clinical diagnosis, noting its predictions are less accurate than AlphaFold's protein-structure results for some variant types, especially enhancers.

zh.title: DeepMind 发布 AlphaGenome Atlas：一次算完全部 90 亿种人类基因突变
zh.excerpt: 谷歌 DeepMind 将约 90 亿个单核苷酸变异的分子效应预计算为一个 1PB 的免费数据集，规模约为 AlphaFold 数据库的 30 倍。
zh.content:
**为基因组「暗物质」绘制参考地图**

- **规模：** 人类基因组约有 30 亿个碱基对。每个位置有 4 种碱基、3 种可能替换，因此单核苷酸变异总数约 90 亿种。逐一在实验室验证几乎不可能，而用 AI 模型逐个变异跑一遍预计需要约 285 年。
- **资源本体：** 该 Atlas 于 2026 年 9 月 8 日发布，是依托 DeepMind 于 2025 年 1 月首次发布的 AlphaGenome 模型预计算出的 1PB 数据集，规模约为 AlphaFold 数据库的 30 倍。每个变异包含数千项分子效应预测，平均约 2.7 万项，覆盖数百种人类与小鼠细胞类型和组织。
- **预测内容：** 基因表达、RNA 剪接、染色质可及性与 DNA 三维构象，并覆盖超 1 亿个插入/缺失变异和数千个重复出现的 DNA 基序。
- **AVI 评分：** DeepMind 推出 AlphaGenome 变异影响（AVI）评分，将 AlphaGenome 的预测与处理蛋白改变型变异的 AlphaMissense 结合为单一指标，在约占 2% 的蛋白编码区与约 98% 的非编码区之间统一排序变异影响，直指此前难以解读的非编码 DNA「暗物质」。
- **获取方式：** 与此前仅约 9000 名研究者使用、且需要编程的 API 不同，Atlas 可通过浏览器访问，无需写代码。面向非商业研究免费，商业访问计划通过 Google Cloud 提供。
- **早期成果：** Broad Institute 的研究者利用 AVI 评分，在一个未解的罕见病病例中，通过预测出的错误 RNA 剪接位点锁定了一个与癫痫性脑病相关的 DNM1 基因变异。埃克塞特大学研究者将其应用于 5.4 万余名英国生物银行参与者，发现非编码区遗传关联多出 22%，并识别出 19 个与 BMI 相关的区域。
- **局限：** DeepMind 将该 Atlas 定位为研究工具与指引，而非实验室实验的替代或独立的临床诊断依据，并指出对某些变异类型（尤其是增强子），其预测准确度不及 AlphaFold 的蛋白结构结果。

en.title: AgiBot's AGILE 2.0 Lets Humanoid Robots 'Move What They See'
en.excerpt: The Chinese robotics firm's vision end-to-end model fuses perception and whole-body control into one closed loop, letting the Lingxi X2 balance on a rolling ball — a claimed industry first for a bipedal humanoid.
en.content:
**Closing the Perception-to-Action Gap**

- **The Model:** AgiBot (Zhiyuan Robotics) released AGILE 2.0 — the AGIBOT Generative Intelligent Locomotion Engine — around September 9, 2026. It uses a vision end-to-end approach whose core breakthrough is a unified perception-control closed loop.
- **The Problem It Solves:** The gap between camera capture, AI computation, and millisecond-level motor response means a lagging visual signal issuing motion commands directly tends to make robots shake, sway, and move unstably. AgiBot frames the industry's hard problem as "seeing is not difficult; the hard part is moving exactly as you see."
- **What Changed From 1.0:** Where AGILE 1.0 connected perception and locomotion, version 2.0 deeply couples the full chain — environmental observation, terrain understanding, dynamic traversability analysis, whole-body motion control, contact-state switching, and fine end-effector manipulation — into an end-to-end mechanism with no intermediate modules and no manually staged decomposition.
- **Capabilities:** Real-time closed-loop visual inference with extreme dynamic constraint optimization, adapting to violent environmental change and moving obstacles; cross-robot state awareness and whole-body behavioral coordination for two-person and multi-person collaborative work; and safety protection with autonomous recovery when humans intrude or interact unexpectedly.
- **The Demo:** In a short film titled *Acrobatics BOT*, the Lingxi X2 running AGILE 2.0 jumped through a ring of fire, performed diabolo tricks, jumped a long rope, did a two-person leapfrog, climbed a high platform in pairs, juggled three balls, and cooperatively carried boxes. It also demonstrated "walking while balanced on a rolling ball" — which AgiBot says is an industry first for a bipedal humanoid, showcasing dynamic balance and locomotion. The rope-jumping and box-carrying segments demonstrated simultaneous fine manipulation during dynamic movement and multi-robot coordination.
- **Why It Matters:** AgiBot says the model breaks the constraint that robots can only work in structured environments, making them adaptable to dynamic disturbances, human-robot coexistence, and multi-robot collaboration. The company positions it as the locomotion intelligence foundation for scaled deployment of humanoid robots, reducing the cost of bespoke development for real-world physical settings. The company also released GE-Act 2.0, a native world-action model, the same day.

zh.title: 智元 AGILE 2.0 发布：让机器人进入「睁眼运动」时代
zh.excerpt: 智元的视觉端到端感控一体模型将感知与全身控制融合为统一闭环，灵犀 X2 完成「踩球行走」——智元称这是双足人形机器人的行业首次。
zh.content:
**弥合「看见」与「行动」之间的鸿沟**

- **模型：** 智元机器人于 2026 年 9 月 9 日前后发布 AGILE 2.0（AGIBOT Generative Intelligent Locomotion Engine）感控一体模型，采用视觉端到端方案，核心突破是视觉端到端感控一体闭环。
- **解决的问题：** 相机采集、AI 计算与电机毫秒级响应之间存在时间差，滞后的视觉信号直接指挥运动，容易导致机器人抖动、晃动、动作不稳。智元将行业难题概括为「看见不难，难的是所见即所动」。
- **相比 1.0 的进化：** AGILE 1.0 打通了感知与运动链路，2.0 则把环境观测、地形理解、动态可通行性分析、全身运动控制、接触状态切换、末端精细操作等全链路深度耦合，构建端到端、无中间模块、无人工阶段拆分的一体化运行机制。
- **能力：** 支持视觉闭环实时推理与极限动态约束优化，适应环境剧烈变化和障碍动态演变；支持跨机器人状态感知与全身行为协同，面向双人、多人协同作业；支持人机共存下的安全防护与自主恢复，应对人员随机闯入、意外交互等场景。
- **演示：** 在创意短片《杂技 BOT》中，搭载 AGILE 2.0 的灵犀 X2 完成钻火圈、抖空竹、跳长绳、双人跳山羊、双人协作上高台、抛三球、协作搬箱子等任务，并展示「踩球行走」。智元称，双足人形机器人自主踩球行走为行业首次，体现动态平衡与运动能力；跳长绳、搬箱子等则展示了动态移动中同步进行精细操作及多机协同能力。
- **意义：** 智元表示，该模型打破了机器人仅能在结构化环境下作业的局限，可适配动态扰动、人机共存、多机协同等真实复杂场景，降低现实物理世界中的定制化开发代价，为人形机器人「部署态」规模化落地提供运动智能底座。同日，智元还发布了 GE-Act 2.0 原生世界—动作模型。

en.title: Ant International, Visa and Mastercard Build a 'Know Your Agent' Trust Framework
en.excerpt: The three payment giants are collaborating on interoperable identity verification for AI agents that shop on users' behalf, working through Singapore's MAS-convened BuildFin.ai platform.
en.content:
**Identity Infrastructure for Agentic Commerce**

- **The Announcement:** Ant International, Mastercard, and Visa launched a collaboration to develop a Know-Your-Agent (KYA) interoperability framework — a shared trust framework for identifying and verifying AI agents that make purchases on behalf of users.
- **Why It's Needed:** The goal is to help card networks, digital wallet ecosystems, agent platforms, and online marketplaces streamline agent onboarding and identification across different payment ecosystems. Trust signals for verified agents would be recognized across networks while each network retains its own verification and decision-making processes, reducing duplicate identity checks and integration complexity — and enabling faster time-to-market and lower costs for new agentic payment services.
- **Three Focus Areas:** Cross-network operator traceability, linking each agent to a validated operator, cardholder, or business for clear attribution; shared certification requirements, assessing agents against agreed security and behavioral standards; and continuous transaction monitoring, ongoing evaluation using identity and transaction-related signals.
- **Building on Existing Protocols:** Visa's Trusted Agent Protocol, Mastercard's Verifiable Intent, and Ant International's Agentic Mobile Protocol.
- **Governance:** The companies will collaborate through BuildFin.ai, an industry platform convened by the Monetary Authority of Singapore, building on MAS's SAFR (Safeguards for Agentic Finance at Runtime) framework.
- **What's Still Open:** The effort is framed as exploration toward common principles. No implementation timetable, technical specification, or list of participating merchants and institutions has been provided, and questions about liability, revocation, and governance remain unresolved.
- **Market Context:** The initiative comes as AI agents evolve from making recommendations to completing purchases. By 2030, AI agents are projected to orchestrate between US$3 trillion and US$5 trillion of global consumer commerce. Visa's Rubail Birwadker said such collaborations can create "more consistency, better accountability, and greater confidence," while Mastercard's Pablo Fourez called interoperability across KYA frameworks "essential to making agentic commerce work at scale." Ant International's Jiang-Ming Yang said interoperable KYA between card and wallet networks is "critical for securing trust."

zh.title: 蚂蚁国际联合 Visa、万事达卡共建 AI 智能体「知代理」信任框架
zh.excerpt: 三大支付机构正合作制定可互操作的 AI 智能体身份核验框架，用于识别代用户下单的智能体，相关工作通过新加坡金管局召集的 BuildFin.ai 平台推进。
zh.content:
**为智能体商业搭建身份基础设施**

- **发布：** 蚂蚁国际、万事达卡与 Visa 宣布合作开发「知代理」（Know-Your-Agent，KYA）互操作框架——一套用于识别与核验代用户完成购买的 AI 智能体的共享信任框架。
- **为何需要：** 目标是帮助卡组织、数字钱包生态、智能体平台与线上商城，在不同支付生态之间简化智能体的接入与身份识别。已核验智能体的信任信号可跨网络互认，同时各网络保留自身的核验与决策流程，从而减少重复身份校验与集成复杂度，让新的智能体支付服务更快上市、成本更低。
- **三大重点：** 跨网络运营方可追溯性，将每个智能体关联到已验证的运营方、持卡人或企业，实现清晰归因；共享认证要求，依据共同商定的安全与行为标准评估智能体；持续交易监控，利用身份与交易相关信号进行持续评估。
- **沿用的既有协议：** Visa 的 Trusted Agent Protocol、万事达卡的 Verifiable Intent，以及蚂蚁国际的 Agentic Mobile Protocol。
- **治理路径：** 三家公司将通过 BuildFin.ai 开展协作，这是由新加坡金融管理局（MAS）召集的行业平台，建立在 MAS 的 SAFR（智能体金融运行时保障）框架之上。
- **尚未确定：** 该合作被定位为对共同原则的探索，目前未给出实施时间表、技术规范或参与商户与机构名单，责任归属、撤销机制与治理等问题仍悬而未决。
- **市场背景：** 此举正值 AI 智能体从「给出建议」演进到「完成购买」。预计到 2030 年，AI 智能体将促成 3 万亿至 5 万亿美元的全球消费者交易。Visa 的 Rubail Birwadker 表示，此类合作能带来「更高的一致性、更好的可问责性与更强的信心」；万事达卡的 Pablo Fourez 称 KYA 框架间的互操作「对智能体商业实现规模化至关重要」；蚂蚁国际的杨江明则表示，卡网络与钱包网络之间可互操作的 KYA 对「建立信任至关重要」。

en.title: DeepSeek Prepares Shanghai STAR Market IPO Alongside Its Model Launch
en.excerpt: CITIC Securities has entered due diligence for a DeepSeek listing on Shanghai's STAR Market, where new rules let unprofitable large-model companies list. Reported H1 revenue was about 47.5 million yuan.
en.content:
**A Two-Track Push**

- **The Mandate:** Reuters first reported on September 8, 2026 that DeepSeek had engaged CITIC Securities to prepare a STAR Market IPO on the Shanghai Stock Exchange, potentially starting the listing process within the year. On September 9, people familiar with the matter confirmed CITIC Securities has begun due diligence. The two sides have not yet signed a formal listing tutoring agreement, and DeepSeek has not publicly commented.
- **Use of Proceeds:** DeepSeek reportedly intends to raise funds to expand compute infrastructure, increase model R&D and in-house chip development, and strengthen incentives for core talent.
- **Funding History:** The company completed its first external funding round in June 2026, raising over 50 billion yuan at a post-money valuation above 350 billion yuan (some reports say close to 400 billion), with founder Liang Wenfeng contributing roughly 20 billion yuan personally and Tencent about 10 billion yuan; CATL-affiliated entities, JD.com, NetEase, and IDG Capital also participated. A second round launched in July pushed the pre-money valuation to about 500 billion yuan. Combined, the two rounds raised over 100 billion yuan. Market estimates put a post-IPO valuation at 1.5 trillion to 2.5 trillion yuan.
- **The Policy Window:** In June 2026, the Shanghai Stock Exchange issued guidance extending the fifth STAR Market listing standard to AI large-model companies. That standard does not require profitability.
- **A Note of Caution:** Veteran investment banker Wang Jiyue noted that the tutoring and filing process takes at least three months, meaning DeepSeek could not submit IPO application materials before the second quarter of 2027 at the earliest. As of September 9, the Zhejiang securities regulator's website showed no listing tutoring filing for DeepSeek — the IPO remains at an early stage.
- **Financials (unaudited):** According to The Information, citing people familiar with the matter, DeepSeek generated about 475 million yuan in revenue in the first seven months of 2026, roughly a tenfold increase over all of 2025, with a blended gross margin of 44.6% and an API gross margin of 82.9%. Net loss for the period was 715 million yuan, with compute infrastructure spending of about 11 billion yuan.
- **Sector Context:** Zhipu and MiniMax listed in Hong Kong in January 2026. Zhipu priced at HK$116.2 and briefly passed a HK$1 trillion market cap before falling back to HK$425.3 billion as of September 9, and began a return-to-A-share process in June. MiniMax priced at HK$165, jumped 109% on its first day, and briefly exceeded HK$410 billion before settling near HK$112 billion. Analysts say capital markets have shifted from valuing AI companies on sector narrative toward scrutinizing business model, earnings quality, and resilience.

zh.title: DeepSeek 被曝备战科创板 IPO，与新模型发布同日推进
zh.excerpt: 中信证券已就 DeepSeek 登陆上交所科创板展开尽职调查，新规允许未盈利的大模型企业上市。据报道其前 7 个月营收约 4750 万元。
zh.content:
**双线并进**

- **保荐安排：** 路透社于 2026 年 9 月 8 日率先报道，DeepSeek 已聘请中信证券筹备上交所科创板 IPO，有望年内启动上市流程。9 月 9 日，知情人士证实中信证券已与 DeepSeek 接洽并进入尽职调查阶段，但双方尚未签署正式的上市辅导协议，DeepSeek 官方未公开回应。
- **募资用途：** 据悉，DeepSeek 希望通过 IPO 募集资金用于扩大算力基础设施建设、加大模型研发与芯片自研投入，并强化核心人才激励。
- **融资历程：** 公司于 2026 年 6 月完成首轮外部融资，募资超 500 亿元，投后估值超 3500 亿元（另有报道称近 4000 亿元），创始人梁文锋个人出资约 200 亿元，腾讯出资约 100 亿元，宁德时代体系、京东、网易、IDG 资本等参投。7 月启动第二轮融资，投前估值升至约 5000 亿元。两轮累计募资超 1000 亿元。市场预估上市后整体市值或达 1.5 万亿至 2.5 万亿元。
- **政策窗口：** 2026 年 6 月，上交所发布指引，将科创板第五套上市标准扩大适用至人工智能大模型企业，该标准不强制要求企业盈利。
- **谨慎预期：** 资深投行人士王骥跃表示，按辅导备案不少于三个月的流程计算，DeepSeek 最快也要到 2027 年二季度才能提交 IPO 申报材料。截至 9 月 9 日，浙江证监局官网尚无其上市辅导备案信息，IPO 仍处于早期筹备阶段。
- **财务数据（未经审计）：** 据 The Information 援引知情人士，DeepSeek 2026 年前 7 个月营收约 4.75 亿元，较 2025 年全年增长近 10 倍；综合毛利率 44.6%，API 业务毛利率高达 82.9%。同期净亏损 7.15 亿元，算力基础设施支出约 110 亿元。
- **行业背景：** 智谱和 MiniMax 已于 2026 年 1 月在港交所上市。智谱发行价 116.2 港元，市值一度突破万亿港元，截至 9 月 9 日回落至 4253 亿港元，并于 6 月启动回 A 进程；MiniMax 发行价 165 港元，首日大涨 109%，市值一度超 4100 亿港元，目前约 1120 亿港元。分析认为，资本市场对 AI 公司的估值已从赛道叙事转向对商业模式、盈利质量和抗风险能力的审视。

en.title: Google Ships Gemini 3.8 Flash and a Cyber Variant Locked to Vetted Defenders
en.excerpt: Gemini 3.8 Flash arrives three weeks after 3.7 with a 1M-token context and three thinking levels, while Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber is restricted to governments and critical infrastructure operators via the new Fairwind Program.
en.content:
**Speed Over Frontier Scale**

- **Release Cadence:** Google shipped Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber on September 2, 2026 — just three weeks after Gemini 3.7 Flash, and the third Flash model in six weeks. The gap reflects a strategy of rapid iteration on cheap, fast models rather than waiting on frontier releases.
- **Gemini 3.8 Flash:** Described by Google as its "most intelligent workhorse model," aimed at long-horizon software engineering, agentic workflows, and complex multi-step reasoning. It supports a 1 million token context and three thinking-intensity levels: low, medium, and high.
- **Benchmarks:** Google cites 71–73.7% on DeepSWE v1.1 — close to Claude Opus 5's 74% — plus 54.9% on HLE-Verified, 86.2% on CharXiv Reasoning, and 87.8% on LVBench.
- **Pricing:** Introductory pricing is $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million output tokens, unchanged from 3.7 Flash, rising to $1.50 and $7.50 on January 1, 2027. Google notes the model "works harder" by adding reasoning steps and calling tools repeatedly, which can consume more tokens, and suggests lower reasoning settings or staying on 3.7 Flash for compute-efficiency-sensitive work.
- **Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber:** A cybersecurity-focused variant limited to trusted government authorities, critical infrastructure operators, and software maintainers through Google's new Fairwind Program. It is reported to detect vulnerabilities across more than 20 programming languages with over 70% success and to generate 2.6 times more correct Chrome patches than larger commercial models.
- **Availability:** Gemini 3.8 Flash is available via the Gemini API, Google AI Studio, Android Studio, Antigravity, and Stitch for developers; Gemini Enterprise for businesses; and the Gemini app, AI Mode in Google Search, and Gemini in Sheets for Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers.
- **Skepticism:** Community coverage notes that despite strong benchmark scores, the model still lags higher-end frontier models in real-world testing.

zh.title: 谷歌发布 Gemini 3.8 Flash，并推出仅面向受信防御方的网络安全版本
zh.excerpt: Gemini 3.8 Flash 距 3.7 发布仅三周，支持 100 万 token 上下文与三档思考强度；Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber 则通过新设的 Fairwind 计划仅向政府与关键基础设施运营方开放。
zh.content:
**以速度取胜，而非前沿规模**

- **发布节奏：** 谷歌于 2026 年 9 月 2 日发布 Gemini 3.8 Flash 与 Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber，距 Gemini 3.7 Flash 仅三周，也是六周内的第三款 Flash 模型。这一节奏反映出在廉价快速模型上快速迭代、而非等待前沿版本发布的策略。
- **Gemini 3.8 Flash：** 谷歌称其为「最智能的主力模型」，面向长周期软件工程、智能体工作流与复杂多步推理。支持 100 万 token 上下文，并提供低、中、高三档思考强度。
- **基准表现：** 谷歌给出 DeepSWE v1.1 上 71%–73.7% 的成绩（接近 Claude Opus 5 的 74%），HLE-Verified 54.9%、CharXiv Reasoning 86.2%、LVBench 87.8%。
- **定价：** 促销期定价为每百万输入 token 0.75 美元、输出 3.75 美元，与 3.7 Flash 持平，2027 年 1 月 1 日起涨至 1.50 与 7.50 美元。谷歌提示该模型会通过增加推理步骤、反复调用工具来「更卖力」，从而消耗更多 token，建议对算力成本敏感的场景调低思考档位或继续使用 3.7 Flash。
- **Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber：** 面向网络安全的专用变体，通过谷歌新设的 Fairwind 计划，仅限受信任的政府机构、关键基础设施运营方与软件维护者使用。据报道，它可覆盖 20 多种编程语言、漏洞检出成功率超 70%，生成正确 Chrome 补丁的数量是更大规模商用模型的 2.6 倍。
- **获取方式：** 开发者可通过 Gemini API、Google AI Studio、Android Studio、Antigravity 与 Stitch 使用 Gemini 3.8 Flash；企业可通过 Gemini Enterprise；Google AI Pro 与 Ultra 订阅用户则可在 Gemini 应用、谷歌搜索 AI 模式与 Sheets 中的 Gemini 使用。
- **质疑声音：** 也有社区评论指出，尽管基准成绩亮眼，该模型在真实世界测试中仍落后于更高端的前沿模型。

en.title: Microsoft Pulls Copilot Out of Excel Cells a Year After Launching It
en.excerpt: Microsoft is removing Copilot from Excel cells, reversing a headline feature of its 2025 AI push after users found the inline assistant more disruptive than useful.
en.content:
**A Rollback in the Office AI Push**

- **What Changed:** Microsoft has removed Copilot from Excel cells, changing strategy roughly a year after launching the feature. The inline assistant, which surfaced AI suggestions directly inside spreadsheet cells, is being withdrawn.
- **Why It Matters:** The reversal is a notable step back for Microsoft's sprawling Copilot rollout across Office, where the company has staked much of its enterprise AI narrative. It suggests users found an always-present AI layer inside the cell grid more disruptive to spreadsheets' core interaction model than helpful.
- **Broader Context:** The change comes amid wider industry concern over soaring AI infrastructure investment and unclear profitability, with vendors under pressure to show that AI features earn their keep rather than being added by default.
- **A Contrast:** The rollback lands the same week enterprise agents moved aggressively in the opposite direction — Meta shipping a personal agent that books and buys autonomously, and payments networks building identity rails for agentic commerce. The divergence highlights how uneven the assistant-to-agent transition remains inside established productivity software.

zh.title: 上线一年后，微软把 Copilot 从 Excel 单元格里撤出
zh.excerpt: 微软正将 Copilot 从 Excel 单元格中移除，逆转 2025 年 AI 推广中的一项标志性功能——用户认为内嵌助手更多是干扰而非帮助。
zh.content:
**Office AI 推进中的一次回撤**

- **变化内容：** 微软已将 Copilot 从 Excel 单元格中移除，在上线约一年后改变策略。这项会把 AI 建议直接呈现在电子表格单元格内的内嵌助手功能正在被撤下。
- **意义：** 对微软在 Office 全线铺开的 Copilot 战略而言，这是一次明显的退步，公司此前把企业级 AI 叙事的很大一部分押注于此。这也说明用户认为，常驻于单元格网格内的 AI 层对电子表格的核心交互方式而言干扰大于帮助。
- **更大背景：** 此举正值业界对 AI 基础设施投资激增、盈利前景不明普遍担忧之际，厂商面临证明 AI 功能「物有所值」而非默认堆砌的压力。
- **对照：** 同一周，企业级智能体正朝相反方向猛冲——Meta 推出可自主订票购物的个人智能体，支付网络则在为智能体商业搭建身份基础设施。这种分化凸显出，从「助手」到「智能体」的转变在成熟生产力软件内部仍很不均衡。
